verdict.rationale: Nix handles many items at once mainly through declarative specs. A whole system's packages and configuration are built from one expression and can be rolled back as a unit. The garbage collector removes all unused packages in one pass, and a community user reports reclaiming 30 GB with nix-collect-garbage. However, the documented imperative example (`nix-env --upgrade --attr`) targets a single package, and there is no explicit bulk-selection or batch-command documentation. missing for 10: documented batch/multi-item CLI operations (e.g. upgrade-all or pattern-based selection), agent-oriented bulk automation docs, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
